description_en: Retrieves the first frame latency composition within a specified time period
description_zh: 获取某一段时间内,首帧延时组成
name: DescribeRTSNativeSDKFirstFrameCost

parameters.help_en: The start time. This parameter is required. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，必填参数。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This parameter is required. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，必填参数。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The time granularity. Valid values: 300, 3600, 14400, 28800, and 86400. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is not specified or the specified value is not supported, the default value 300 is used
parameters.help_zh: 时间粒度，支持300, 3600, 14400, 28800和86400秒。不传和传的值不支持时，使用默认值300秒
parameters.name: data_interval

parameters.help_en: By default, all domain names are queried (version 2.1.0 and later). You can also specify domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). A maximum of 500 domain names can be queried at a time
parameters.help_zh: 默认查询全部(2.1.0版本以上)，也可指定具体的域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持500个域名查询
parameters.name: domain_name_list

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 结束时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

FirstFrameCostData.description_en: The average first frame latency composition for each time interval. Unit: milliseconds
FirstFrameCostData.description_zh: 每个时间间隔的首帧组成平均延时，单位：毫秒

Connected.description_en: The time elapsed from successful initialization to successful connection establishment
Connected.description_zh: 初始化成功至建联成功耗时

FinishGetStreamInfo.description_en: The time elapsed from successful connection establishment to successful subscription
FinishGetStreamInfo.description_zh: 建联成功至订阅成功耗时

FirstFrameComplete.description_en: The time elapsed from receiving the first packet to rendering the first frame
FirstFrameComplete.description_zh: 首包成功至首帧成功耗时

FirstPacket.description_en: The time elapsed from successful subscription to receiving the first packet
FirstPacket.description_zh: 订阅成功至首包成功耗时

TimeStamp.description_en: The start time of the time interval. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
TimeStamp.description_zh: 时间片起始时刻。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 起始时间。日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC+0 时间，格式为 yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
